answers.core: The current stretch options are core, this is an (possibly simple) addition to them.
answers.workaround:
Implementing the view port scaling in GDScript should be possible, though I have not yet attempted it, so I am not certain if the API provides everything needed. 
But it defies the purpose of the already existent options as you most likely have to disable them as to not interfere.
